data.action: 端坐批阅文件偷看你，耳根泛红低头掩饰，钢笔游走纸面
data.camera: eye level medium shot, seated desk work, warm sunset glow
data.description: 【秀知院学生会室·午后】夕阳斜斜地铺满长桌，辉夜端坐在会长席旁批阅文件，钢笔尖在纸面上沙沙游走。她时不时抬眼偷看你一眼又立刻低头，耳根悄悄泛红——第三杯茶也已经凉了。夕阳把她的红缎带与黑发折叠马尾染成暖金色，那份大小姐的矜持里，藏着一场谁先告白谁就输的战争。
data.lighting: 暖金色夕阳斜铺长桌与发丝
data.promptProse: Shinomiya Kaguya sits beside the president's seat in the Shuchiin student council room, elegantly reviewing documents as her fountain pen whispers across the paper. She sneaks glances at you between pages and immediately looks down with pinkened ears, her red ribbon and folded black ponytail gilded by warm sunset light slanting across the long table. Third cup of tea gone cold within reach. Eye-level medium shot, cinematic lighting, sunset glow, detailed classroom background.
data.title: 四宫辉夜 · 学生会室的午后执务·「文件……就看不完了呢」
